Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data_dir <- "/Users/sklucas/projects/zcbuanno_2026_bioreactor_seq/results/wf_16s"
tsv_files <- list.files(data_dir, "*_taxonomy-detailed.tsv$", 
                        recursive=TRUE,
                        full.names = TRUE)
tsv_files

```

```{r}
data <- tsv_files %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map_dfr(read_tsv, .id = "source") %>%
  select(source, everything()) %>%
  mutate(source = gsub("/Users/sklucas/projects/zcbuanno_2026_bioreactor_seq/results/wf_16s/", "", source)) %>%
  mutate(source = gsub("_taxonomy-detailed.tsv", "", source)) %>%
  separate(source, sep = "/", into = "source", extra = "drop")
```

```{r}
data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = source, y = abundance, fill = genus)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack")
```
